input: I'm a tenant. My lease is 30 months, rent is R$ 1,800 and it says that if I leave early I pay a penalty of 3 months' rent. I've completed 10 months and want to leave now. How much will I pay?

checks.description: Cites art. 4 of the Tenancy Law
Explains that the penalty is proportional
Calculates the correct proportional penalty: 5,400 × 20 ÷ 30 = R$ 3,600
Reminds the user that this does not replace a lawyer
